header: I use this to extract conversational names and initials from full name strings; it ignores common prefixes, honorifics, and religious abbreviations.

symbols.name: COMMON_PREFIXES
doc: My curated, case-insensitive list of common prefixes and honorifics, widely used in South Asia and globally. Important: keep this in sync with the SQL function public.name_prefixes() (04_phonetic_setup.sql), which employee phonetic search uses.

symbols.name: getStructuralNameParts
doc: I split a name into structural parts here, discarding any configured prefixes.

symbols.name: getFriendlyFirstName
symbols.sig: export function getFriendlyFirstName( fullName: string | null | undefined,): string
doc: I parse a full name here and extract the true conversational call-name.

paramDocs.fullName: The full raw name string (e.g., "MOHD ANWAR ULLAH", "DR GOUTAM SEN")

symbols.name: getInitials
symbols.sig: export function getInitials(fullName: string | null | undefined): string
doc: I generate up to two initials from a name string and ignore common prefixes.

paramDocs.fullName: The full raw name string (e.g., "MOHD ANWAR ULLAH")
